business_summary: Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the production and manufacturing of aero-engine and gas turbine components in China. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Chengfa Aero-Science & Technology Co,Ltd. and changed its name to Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd in April 2017. Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
business_summary_ko: Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd는 중국에서 항공기 엔진 및 가스 터빈 부품을 생산 및 제조하는 회사입니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Sichuan Chengfa Aero-Science & Technology Co,Ltd로 알려졌습니다. Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 청두에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
